title: Gotta Smelt Em All!
description: This mod adds support for items that should be able to be blasted in vanilla, but isnt.
body:
This qol (Quality Of life) mod allows for some more items to be smelted via a blast furnace. 
This is what the mod does, for now.
- Sand = Glass
- Red Sand = Red Stained Glass
- Sandstone = Smooth Sandstone
- Red Sandstone = Red Smooth Sandstone.
